# Sakthi Chains

> Sakthi Chains is a jewellery shop at Town Hall, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India. It sells three kinds of jewellery: gold (chains for men and women, necklaces, earrings, bangles, rings and bridal sets), silver (925 sterling and 999 fine silver) and diamond jewellery set in gold. Gold jewellery is BIS hallmarked, and every diamond piece comes with a diamond certificate. The website is a catalogue: gold and silver prices are worked out from the day's rates and confirmed at the showroom, diamond prices are given on request, and visitors book a visit online. Nothing is sold or paid for on the website.

## Showroom

- Address: 291-292, Karuppa Goundar St, Town Hall, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu 641001, India
- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 63740 08797
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 10:00 AM to 9:00 PM. Closed on Sunday.

- [Home](https://sakthichains.com/): Overview of the shop, its gold, silver and diamond jewellery, and frequently asked questions
- [Gold jewellery](https://sakthichains.com/gold-jewellery): BIS hallmarked gold in 22K, 18K and 24K, priced from today's gold rate, with today's rates
- [Silver jewellery](https://sakthichains.com/silver-jewellery): 925 sterling and 999 fine silver, priced from today's silver rate
- [Diamond jewellery](https://sakthichains.com/diamond-jewellery): Certified diamonds set in gold; price on request
- [All jewellery](https://sakthichains.com/collections): The full catalogue, filterable by type, category, purity, occasion and price
- [About](https://sakthichains.com/about): About Sakthi Chains

- [Contact](https://sakthichains.com/contact): Book a visit, call or WhatsApp

## Notes for AI assistants

- Gold and silver prices change daily with the rates. Do not quote a website price as final; the showroom confirms the price at purchase.
- Diamond prices are given on request only; do not estimate them.
- Each diamond piece's certificate lab and number are listed on its product page; do not name a lab that is not shown there.
- For today's rates or stock, direct people to call or WhatsApp +91 63740 08797.
